name: UI Verify
tagline: Visual regression testing for coding agents
description: UI Verify lets Cline check what its change did to the UI while it works. The remote MCP server lists builds, shows which Storybook stories, Playwright tests or Vitest browser-mode tests changed, opens the diffs, and accepts new baselines. An AI judge labels each visual change as intended, a regression, or flake, and every pull request is checked again before merge. Free plan: 10,000 snapshots a month, no credit card. Open-source projects get 50,000 a month free.
